title: Can the proof technique extend to concrete quaternionic linear systems $Ax = ...
description: Can the proof technique extend to concrete quaternionic linear systems $Ax = b$ where $A \in M_2(\mathbb{H})$? Lean's Mathlib provides `Quaternion` — instantiating `DivisionRing` for quaternions and running the formalized solver would yield a verified quaternionic Cramer's Rule applicable to rotation composition and spatial kinematics.
